plan.english: Where am I? Who are you? You are in the house of the chief. I am his servant, and you are his captive now. What will he do to me? You will grind barley at the quern. I will flee to my mother. The dogs will find you, and he will bind you. Your land is far away, and you do not know the path. Then I will grind. Show me the quern.
